parts.name: M5StickC PLUS2
parts.notes: M5Stack M5StickC PLUS2: ESP32-PICO-V3-02, MPU6886 6-axis IMU, 200 mAh LiPo with built-in USB-C charging, 1.14in screen, 3 buttons. Comes with a USB-C cable. Search 'M5StickC PLUS2' if this listing is out of stock.

parts.name: Magnet 10x3 N52
parts.notes: 10 x 3 mm N52 neodymium disc magnets (pack of 50, ~$9). Press into the rail pockets with a drop of super glue, same pole facing out on all four.

parts.name: Hook-and-loop strap 20 mm
parts.notes: 20 mm x 300 mm hook-and-loop cinch strap (pack of ~20). Threads through the tunnel under the pod and wraps a 25-50 mm bar or dumbbell handle.

parts.name: Super glue (CA) gel
parts.notes: Share of a small tube of CA gel super glue, for the 4 magnets.

parts.name: USB-C cable (included with M5StickC PLUS2)
parts.notes: Ships in the M5StickC PLUS2 box. Charge from any 5 V USB charger.

parts.name: M2.5×8 self-tapping screw for plastic
parts.notes: search: M2.5 x 8mm pan head self tapping screws for plastic
